tests.name: 32 unit, ROS state and lint tests; 1 generated test skipped
Deliberate zero-frequency failure in branch pr04-defect
Live command speeds, 10 to 5 Hz, zero rejection preserves 5 Hz
Clear service request and rotate action discovery

defect.reproducer: In branch pr04-defect, run patrol with the frequency check disabled, then ros2 param set /patrol publish_hz 0.0. Node exits with ZeroDivisionError; the CLI request times out. Real logs are in defect-node.txt and defect-cli.txt.
defect.root_cause: The requested frequency reaches timer recreation without validation. Computing the period 1.0 / 0.0 raises ZeroDivisionError after removing the old timer.
defect.proof_after: The same zero request is rejected before changing state. ros2 param get returns 5.0 and ros2 topic hz still measures 5.000 Hz. Tests verify the timer object and all active values remain unchanged.
